bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up {name}
bluetooth_confirm.description: Confirm setup for {name} ({address}). Leave the token as-is unless your device needs a different one. If the clock is already set up in another app, reset it first (hold the button until the Bluetooth icon flashes).

data_description.token: The clock's 16-byte pairing token (hex). Leave the suggested value to pair this clock only to this Home Assistant. To control the same clock from more than one app or Home Assistant instance, set the same token in each of them, reset the clock, then add it here.

user.title: Qingping CGD1 Alarm Clock
user.description: Choose a discovered clock and enter its auth token. If the clock is already set up in another app, reset it first (hold the button until the Bluetooth icon flashes).

data_description.token: The clock's 16-byte pairing token (hex). Leave the suggested value to pair this clock only to this Home Assistant. To control the same clock from more than one app or Home Assistant instance, set the same token in each of them, reset the clock, then add it here.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect {name}
reauth_confirm.description: This clock is paired with another app and rejected Home Assistant. Reset it first: press and hold the clock's button until the Bluetooth icon flashes (or remove the clock in the Qingping+ app), then try again. Once reset, the clock pairs with the first app that connects, so add it here straight after resetting.

data_description.token: The token this entry already uses. Keep it to re-pair the same clock, or set the same token here and on the clock (after a reset) if you're sharing it with another app or Home Assistant instance.

error.invalid_token: The auth token must be 32 hexadecimal characters (16 bytes).
error.needs_reset: This clock is paired with another app and rejected Home Assistant. Reset it first: press and hold the clock's button until the Bluetooth icon flashes (or remove the clock in the Qingping+ app), then try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the clock. Make sure it is powered on and in range, then try again.
error.unknown: Something went wrong talking to the clock. Check the logs, make sure it is powered on and in range, then try again.

abort.already_configured: This device is already set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No Qingping CGD1 clock was found nearby.
